gemini-3-flash.notes: Good CRA compliance structure but inaccurate CVE counts (claims 7 unique CVEs vs actual 8). Comprehensive but verbose at ~600 words.

gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Strong CRA focus but major accuracy issue claiming 3 CRITICAL CVEs when only 2 exist. Good structure and actionable recommendations.

deepseek-v3.notes: Excellent conciseness at 298 words with good accuracy. Minor completeness issues with advisory count discrepancies but strong overall structure.

glm-4.7.notes: Most accurate CVE counts and severity distribution. Well-structured, concise, and provides specific vulnerability details with clear action items.

analysis: GLM-4.7 achieves the best balance across all criteria with accurate CVE counts, proper severity classification, and concise presentation. DeepSeek-v3 excels in conciseness but has minor accuracy issues, while both Gemini models suffer from CVE count inaccuracies despite good structural approaches.
